description: This file defines classes and constants for managing WebKit protocol connections and sessions within the Playwright testing framework. It includes WKConnection and WKSession classes, handling message dispatch, connection lifecycle, and event emission.

classes.name: WKConnection
classes.description: Manages WebKit protocol connection, message dispatching, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: WKSession
classes.description: Represents a WebKit protocol session, handling message sending, response callbacks, and event emission.

methods.name: nextMessageId
methods.description: Generates a new unique message ID for protocol communication.

methods.name: rawSend
methods.description: Sends a protocol message through the transport layer.

methods.name: _dispatchMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, dispatching them to the appropriate session or ignoring specific messages.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles connection closure, logs, and cleanup.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns whether the connection is closed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection if not already closed.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command message and returns a promise for the response.

methods.name: sendMayFail
methods.description: Sends a command and logs errors without throwing.

methods.name: isDisposed
methods.description: Checks if the session has been disposed.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the session, rejecting all pending callbacks.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages to callbacks or event listeners.
